name: Rockaway Ventures
decision_note: Prague-based VC of the Rockaway Capital group; closed its second fund (Rockaway Ventures II, ~EUR 55m) in May 2025 and invested in Filuta AI (2025), Remix (2025), Apptronik (2026) and led ValkaAI's EUR 12m pre-seed (Feb 2026).

legal_entities.name: Rockaway Ventures Fund SICAV a.s., podfond I

funds.name: Rockaway Ventures II (Rockaway Ventures Fund SICAV a.s.)

evidence.quote: Since 2014, Rockaway Ventures has been investing in areas where the Rockaway Capital group has deep expertise, primarily in retail and e-commerce, travel & hospitality, digital logistics, digital media, cybersecurity, defence, CleanTech, and PropTech.
Our investment strategy is centered around early-stage startups with a focus on Seed to Series A stage companies in the CEE and DACH regions
Known for its early investments in e-commerce and travel tech, the fund is now focusing on sectors such as energy, defense, and dual-use technologies.
has closed its second fund, Rockaway Ventures II, at nearly €55 million.
Rockaway Ventures has led a $4.2 million (approximately €3.9 million) seed round in Filuta AI, a Czech startup based in Prague that is developing advanced AI solutions for automated game testing.
Čeští investoři z Rockaway Ventures finančně vstoupili do americké společnosti
Rockaway Ventures získává 20% podíl v Remixu
Fondu Naše Česko J&T Investiční společnosti a právě Rockaway Ventures, který kolo vedl.

analyst_notes: Fund size: tech.eu says 'nearly €55 million' (recorded as 55000000, approximate); about 25% from Rockaway Capital, rest from private (mainly Czech) investors. Event date = article date 2025-05-16. The fund was launched in 2022 per tech.eu. Ticket size not published by the investor. Geography: own site says CEE and DACH; tech.eu adds a planned 60% CEE / 40% Western Europe and US-based diaspora startups split. Sector list mapped from the site's list (travel & hospitality has no exact sector code and is not mapped). Apptronik: Rockaway joined the USD 520m Series A extension (round amount is the whole extension; Rockaway's share undisclosed); the company name in the Lupa sentence is a link, so the quote stops before it; the same article gives the USD 520m extension. Remix: 20% stake acquired, amount undisclosed. Legal: the SICAV's statutory body is the white-label manager AMISTA investiční společnost, a.s. (IČO 27437558); Rockaway Ventures Advisors a.s. board = the investment team (D. Zábrodský, A. Lauren, J. Havrlant), so it is recorded as manager. ValkaAI: Rockaway Ventures led the EUR 12m pre-seed (CzechCrunch 2026-02-24), alongside J&T Ventures, Tensor Ventures, BD Partners and Fond Naše Česko.
